info.title: Kardow Public API
info.description: Public API for jobs and member automation on Kardow.

get.description: Retrieve jobs for your organization with search, filtering, and pagination.

parameters.name: posted_within
parameters.description: Only jobs posted within a recent window. Use 7d for "this week".

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Only jobs posted on or after this ISO 8601 date. Combine with date_to for a custom range.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Only jobs posted on or before this ISO 8601 date.

List every CMS collection in your organization.

post.description: Upserts a CMS collection by slug. The schema array defines the fields each item in the collection must (or may) provide.

get.description: List custom pages and blog posts (both are custom_pages rows).

post.description: Create a custom page or blog post. Send content as HTML (recommended) or TipTap JSON.

get.description: Fetch a single page or blog post, including its body as content (TipTap JSON), content_html, and content_text.

patch.description: Update a page or blog post. Only the fields you send are changed. Passing content replaces the body.

get.description: List/search the media library. URLs are always cdn.kardow.com links.

post.description: Add an image by URL (JSON body { source_url }) or by uploading a file (multipart/form-data with a file field). Returns a hosted cdn.kardow.com URL.
Idempotent: returns the existing category id if the name already exists.

get.description: List the org's normalized, geocoded locations (behind location landing pages). Read-only; created automatically when jobs are posted with a location.

post.description: Turn free text into a specific place on this board. Without `create` it previews candidates and writes nothing; with `create: true` it commits the best match and returns its id for use as `location_id` on a job. Street addresses resolve to their parent city. Lookup order is the board existing locations, then a shared geocode cache, then the geocoder, so repeats and places you already cover cost nothing.

query.description: Place description: a city, a full street address, a postal code, or "Remote".

country.description: Two-letter country code to disambiguate, e.g. "ca".

create.description: true commits the best match and returns its id.

200.description: Candidate matches (create was false, or the place already existed)

ambiguous.description: True when several plausible matches exist and the first should not be used unattended.

404.description: No place found for the query

422.description: The value was refused as a browsable place (street address or placeholder text)

get.description: List job board users (job seekers and employers) with custom signup fields projected into readable keys. Requires members:read scope.
The org's custom signup field schema. Pass format=zapier for Zapier outputFields shape.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for authentication. Get yours from Settings > API Keys in the Kardow dashboard.

url.description: Full public URL on the live board.

content_html.description: Body rendered as HTML (easiest to read/revise).

content.description:
Body as HTML (recommended) or TipTap JSON. Supported HTML: headings, p, strong/em/s, code, ul/ol/li, blockquote, pre>code, hr, a, img, text-align, text color, and YouTube embeds (
).

kind.description: blog_post for a blog article, page for a standalone page.

cover_image.description: Cover image URL, ideally from the Assets API.

meta_description.description: SEO description; also the blog card summary.

User.description: A job board user (job seeker or employer). Custom signup fields appear as additional readable keys.

label.description: Optional human label shown in UIs.

default.description: Default value when none is provided.

id.description: Provide to update an existing item.

url.description: Full public URL to the job on the live board (active custom domain when available).

slug.description: URL path only, without the domain.

how_to_apply.description: Where a candidate applies (URL, email, or phone). Not the same as url.

posted_at.description: When the job was posted. Alias of created_at.

apply_url.description: Preferred field for the application destination — an external URL, email address, or phone number. Alias of how_to_apply (which is still accepted).

apply_type.description: Preferred field for how candidates apply. Alias of how_to_apply_method.

how_to_apply.description: Required unless how_to_apply_method is "form". Where candidates apply: an external URL, an email address, or a phone number. A method of email/website/phone/form-external with no destination is rejected with 422 invalid_apply_destination.

how_to_apply_method.description: What the apply button does: form-external, website, email, phone, or form. Must match the how_to_apply value. Only "form" takes no destination. Omit to auto-detect from how_to_apply.

posted_by_email.description: Email of the employer account posting this job. Must match a job board user in the org, else the request returns 422 employer_not_found.

category.description: Category name (e.g. Engineering). Matched to an existing category or created if new.

location.description: Location shown on the job. Resolved to a real place and linked, so the job appears on the right location page and filter. Street addresses are filed under their city; exact coordinates stay on the job.

category_id.description: Existing category UUID. Takes precedence over category if both are sent.

location_id.description: Existing location id from POST /locations. Takes precedence over `location` text and skips resolution.

location_country.description: Two-letter country code used when resolving `location` text, e.g. "ca". Ignored when location_id is given.

slug.description: URL path only, without the domain.

url.description: Full public URL to the created job on the live board.

board_url.description: Base public URL of the job board.

url.description: Full public URL for the created job (same as data.url).
Full public URL to the job on the live board.

slug.description: URL path only, without the domain.

source.description: How the job was created: user, admin, scraper, api, or bulk_upload.

form_data.description: Custom application field values, if the board uses them.

location.description: Location shown on the job. Resolved to a real place and linked, so the job appears on the right location page and filter. Street addresses are filed under their city; exact coordinates stay on the job.

location_id.description: Existing location id from POST /locations. Takes precedence over `location` text and skips resolution.

location_country.description: Two-letter country code used when resolving `location` text, e.g. "ca". Ignored when location_id is given.

how_to_apply.description: Required unless how_to_apply_method is "form". Where candidates apply: an external URL, an email address, or a phone number. A method of email/website/phone/form-external with no destination is rejected with 422 invalid_apply_destination.

how_to_apply_method.description: What the apply button does: form-external, website, email, phone, or form. Must match the how_to_apply value. Only "form" takes no destination. Omit to auto-detect from how_to_apply.

authMethod.description: How the member authenticates (e.g. password, oauth).

id.description: Location entity id, or null when this place is not on the board yet.

full_address.description: Street-level address that matched, when the query was an address.
